title: French Cassoulet
description: A classic French dish made with white beans, meat, and sometimes lamb. It's a hearty casserole that's perfect for special occasions. This version features juicy sausages and a crispy, golden-brown crust.

ingredients.name: Bake
ingredients.notes: cassoulet dish or 9x13 inch baking dish

instructions: Brown the sausages in a large skillet over medium-high heat, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausages from the skillet and set aside.
Add the Croatian white beans to the skillet and cook until they're lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the beans to the bake and arrange the sausages on top.
Cover the bake with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove the cassoulet from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
